svg.title: Online Fashion Retail Store ERD
svg.desc: Sixteen entities with attributes, primary and foreign keys, and fifteen crow’s-foot relationships.
svg.text: Online Fashion Retail Store — Entity Relationship Diagram
Owner, author, maintainer: Emmanuel Madueke | Proposed keys and attributes; physical types pending
Legend: PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; || = exactly one; circle + crow’s foot = zero or many.
Circle + bar = zero or one. Completed orders require items; sellable products require active variants.
At most one active cart/customer and successful payment/order. Administrator relationships are deferred.
Product → Product Variant — 1:many (0..many; active variant needed to sell)
Product Variant → Inventory — 1:1 (mandatory on both sides)
Product Variant → Cart Item — 1:many (0..many cart lines)
Order → Order Item — 1:many (0..many; completed order needs ≥1)
Product Variant → Order Item — 1:many (0..many purchase lines)
Order → Payment — 1:many (0..many attempts; at most 1 success)
Each child has exactly one parent in every relationship above. Administrator has no defined relationship yet.
Cart ↔ Variant and Order ↔ Variant are many:many, resolved through Cart Item and Order Item respectively.
